metadata.description: AI Sentinels workshop packs: pick the packs that match your role.

plugins.name: ai-sentinels-core
plugins.description: Everyday AI for every staff member: plan your day, keep context, search across email, chat and documents, work with PDFs. Includes the AI Sentinels setup wizard, time-saved log and Copilot agents guide.

plugins.name: ai-sentinels-people-ops
plugins.description: People and operations: HR policy answers, onboarding, interviews and reviews; process docs, runbooks, status reports, risk and vendor reviews; stakeholder updates and planning.

plugins.name: ai-sentinels-comms
plugins.description: Marketing and communications: content in your brand voice, campaign plans, email sequences, brand review, SEO and performance reports.

plugins.name: ai-sentinels-finance-data
plugins.description: Finance and data: month-end close, reconciliations, variance analysis, audit support; explore spreadsheets and data, build charts and dashboards, check analysis before sharing.

plugins.name: ai-sentinels-business-growth
plugins.description: Business growth for sales teams and small businesses: prospect research, call prep, outreach, pipeline and forecasts, plus ready-made small-business workflows for inbox, invoices, proposals and reporting.
